user.title: Battery & Solar Setup
user.description: Tell the Peak Shaver about your battery system and solar forecast source.

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor reporting available battery energy in kWh
data_description.solar_forecast_entity: Solcast or Forecast.Solar sensor with hourly forecast data
data_description.battery_capacity: Total usable capacity of your battery system
data_description.base_load_kw: Your average hourly power draw during a typical day
data_description.min_safe_soc_kwh: Battery floor - the level you never want to go below
data_description.solar_actual_entity: Sensor reporting cumulative solar production today in kWh (enables forecast accuracy tracking)

schedule.title: Rate Schedule
schedule.description: Set your TOU rate tiers and when the shaver should run its calculations.

data_description.midpeak_start_hour: When mid-peak rates begin - cheaper than peak, more expensive than off-peak
data_description.peak_start_hour: When the most expensive rates begin
data_description.peak_end_hour: When peak rates end and off-peak resumes
data_description.weekdays_only: Most TOU plans only have peak pricing on weekdays
data_description.schedule_hours: Hours to run overnight calculations, e.g. 3,4,5,6

notifications.title: Notifications & Off-Peak Hold
notifications.description: Configure notifications and off-peak battery hold for low-solar months.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Send notifications when charging decisions are made
data_description.charge_threshold: Ignore charge amounts below this level
data_description.seasonal_preservation: After peak ends in low-solar months, hold battery level and draw from grid instead of draining stored energy
data_description.seasonal_months: Months when solar won't refill the battery, e.g. 11,12,1,2,3
data_description.verbose_logging: Show full simulation table in System Logs

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found in Home Assistant
error.invalid_time_range: Rate periods must be in order: mid-peak < peak < end

recalculate.name: Recalculate
recalculate.description: Run the peak shaving calculation immediately and update all sensors.

performance_report.name: Performance Report
performance_report.description: Get performance scorecards for recent days.

export_history.name: Export History
export_history.description: Export performance history as CSV for statistical analysis.

backfill_learning.name: Backfill Learned Model
backfill_learning.description: Rebuild the learned battery curves and load profile from recorder statistics, so the learned planner does not start cold.

data.load_power_entity: House load power sensor (inverter AC output)
data.full_charge_months: Months that charge to full every TOU night
data.load_quantile: Plan for this share of days (load quantile)
data.solar_confidence: Share of forecast solar to count on
data.gauge_floor_pct: Gauge reading at which the inverter hands over to grid
data.handover_recovery_pct: Gauge the inverter recharges to after a handover
data.peak_margin_kwh: Reserve to keep above the handover at peak end
data.stale_minutes: Minutes without change that mean the battery data is frozen
data.pack_current_charge_positive: Pack current is positive when charging
data.pack_capacity_ah: Rated capacity of each third-party pack

data_description.planner: classic: the original planner controls the inverter and the learned planner only reports. learned: the learned planner controls the inverter.
data_description.gauge_entity: The percent the inverter itself reports. Leave empty to derive it from the battery SOC sensor and the capacity.
data_description.load_power_entity: Needed for learning. Power the inverter delivers to the house.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Needed for learning. Power the inverter takes from the grid.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Optional. Solar power into the inverter.
data_description.solar_forecast_tomorrow_entity: Optional. Guessed from today's forecast sensor when empty.
data_description.load_quantile: 0.8 means the plan covers the load of 8 days out of 10.
data_description.solar_confidence: 0.7 means only 70 percent of the forecast is relied on.
data_description.handover_recovery_pct: After handing the house to the grid at the floor, the inverter grid-charges its battery back to this level and stays on grid. The learned planner counts that charge as a cost of running out in peak.
data_description.peak_margin_kwh: The learned planner tops up in mid-peak if the battery would end peak with less than this above the handover.
data_description.stale_minutes: If neither the gauge nor any power sensor changes for this long, the readings count as missing: no learning, safe fallbacks, one alert. 0 turns the check off.
data_description.pack_current_entities: Optional. One current sensor per pack the inverter does not manage. Adds a charge estimate (amp-hours from the last full charge) and a capacity trend sensor per pack after a restart. Voltage and percent sensors of the same pack are found by name (..._voltage, ..._battery).
data_description.pack_current_charge_positive: Turn off if the pack reports discharge as a positive current.
data_description.bus_voltage_entity: Optional. Empty: the mean of the packs' own voltage sensors.
data_description.pack_capacity_ah: Used to turn amp-hours since full into a percent.
data_description.capacity_v_high: Each discharge from full is measured from where the bus falls through this voltage.
data_description.capacity_v_low: ... to where it falls through this one. Pick two that most deep evenings reach.

error.invalid_voltage_range: The lower voltage must be below the upper voltage.
